author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
There will be huge growth in early childhood. #ncsc17 expansion in suburbs should begin at PreK while those who care about accountability measures in our urban schools should expand down.

In the burbs parents join for the daycare. In the city we know enough to know we must start as early as possible.
